question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Swindle
solution:
The correct answer is "**Fraud**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Swindle" means to cheat or deceive someone, especially in order to get money from them unfairly.**(ठगी)

 
 
• Example: They swindled local businesses out of thousands of dollars.
 
 
 
• **Fraud is a synonym of swindle, which means intentional deception to secure unfair or unlawful gain.**(धोखा)
 
 
• Example: They became a victim of the fraud.
 
 
 
 
 
• Other synonyms of swindle include cheat, con, deceive, and defraud.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 - Threat: a statement or action that is intended to intimidate someone. This is not a synonym of swindle.(धमकी)
 
• Option 3 - Observation: the action or process of observing something or someone carefully or in order to gain information. This is not a synonym of swindle.(अवलोकन)
 
• Option 4 - Ride: a journey made on horseback, on a bicycle or in a vehicle. This is not a synonym of swindle.(सवारी)
